hints.title: Game Transition Invariant
hints.text: A valid move must be lexicographically larger with the same initial letter, or have its first letter exactly adjacent in the alphabet.

hints.title: Optimal Step Monotonicity
hints.text: Because word lists are sorted, both players greedily advance through their respective lists picking the earliest valid continuation.

hints.title: Two Pointer Simulation
hints.text: Maintain pointer i for Alice and pointer j for Bob. If a player runs out of candidate words, the other player immediately wins.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear two-pointer scan through both sorted word lists.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Game tree minimax search branches exponentially.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that greedy two-pointer scanning simulates optimal play without searching.
